pages.title: Attio MCP | Attio Help Center (https://attio.com/help/reference/attio-ai/attio-mcp)
pages.text: Attio MCP | Attio Help Center Help / Reference / Attio AI / Attio MCP Table of Contents What is MCP? Who should use Attio MCP? What you can do with Attio MCP When to use Attio MCP or Ask Attio How to get started Available on all plans. Available for all workspace members. Using the Model Context Protocol, Attio MCP enables compatible AI assistants to securely access and take action on your CRM data once it has been configured and authenticated. This makes it possible to search, create, and update records, work with notes, and manage tasks in Attio using natural language. If you are building AI powered workflows or connecting AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, or other MCP compatible clients to Attio, this is the supported way to do it. What is MCP? Copy link MCP stands for Model Context Protocol. It is an open standard that allows AI assistants to securely interact with external tools and data sources. Attio’s MCP implementation provides a structured and permissioned way for AI assistants to access your workspace. Actions are authenticated and respect your existing workspace permissions. Who should use Attio MCP? Copy link Attio MCP is for anyone who wants to connect an external AI assistant to their Attio workspace. This can include developers building custom workflows, as well as operators or team members who want to use AI assistants like ChatGPT or other MCP compatible clients to query or update CRM data. If you are only using AI features inside Attio, you do not need MCP. MCP is only required when connecting an external AI assistant to your workspace. What you can do with Attio MCP Copy link With Attio MCP, compatible AI assistants can: Search for people, companies, deals, and other records Create and update records Create custom objects, enable standard objects, and create attributes on objects Create, update, and delete views on objects and lists, including their filters, sorts, shown attributes, and kanban settings Search, create, and update notes Search emails and meetings Create, update, and delete tasks Create and update lists, and update list entries Access is scoped to your authenticated Attio account, so AI assistants can only access data and take actions that you already have permission to access in your workspace. Example use cases Copy link See Attio MCP: prompts and best practices for a range of example use cases. When to use Attio MCP or Ask Attio Copy link Ask Attio allows you to use AI directly inside Attio. It is designed for fast, in product answers and assistance with your workspace, with no additional setup required. Attio MCP is a good fit when you want to connect Attio to external AI assistants and workflows. For example: Using AI assistants like ChatGPT or Claude to generate structured outputs such as sales summaries or reports based on your CRM data Connecting Attio with other MCP enabled tools to move or sync information between systems Using more advanced AI agent environments that can combine Attio with custom scripts or multi step automations Ask Attio and MCP are complementary, and the best option depends on whether you are working inside Attio or connecting Attio to external systems. How to get started Copy link To set up and configure Attio MCP, including authentication and supported actions, refer to the developer documentation for Attio MCP . The developer docs provide full setup instructions, technical requirements, and implementation details. To see example prompts and best practices for using the Attio MCP, see Attio MCP: prompts and best practices . Did this article answer your question? Yes No Search... ⌘K

pages.title: MCP Integration | Attio (https://attio.com/apps/mcp)
pages.text: MCP Integration | Attio Apps / MCP [V 1.0 ] Official app Built by Attio Category Analytics Resources Website Documentation Support Install app Overview Attio provides a hosted MCP server that gives AI tools secure access to your Attio workspace. It’s designed to work seamlessly with popular AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and more. How it works Once connected, your AI assistant can: Look up contacts and companies , like "Find all contacts at Stripe" or "Who's the decision maker at Notion?" Search your pipeline , like "Find all Series B companies in our CRM" or "Show me contacts who are CTOs or VPs of Engineering." Log notes and activity , like "Log a note on the Linear account: had a great demo call, they want to see pricing." Create and manage tasks, like "Add a task to follow up with Ramp in 3 days." Surface insights from calls and emails, like "Find calls where we discussed enterprise pricing" or "Find emails discussing contract renewal." Manage lists and pipelines , like "Add Acme to the sales pipeline" or "Update Acme's entry to Proposal Sent." Run reports , like "Count open deals by stage" or "Show average deal size by owner." Add comments and collaborate , like "Add a comment to the Acme company record: waiting on legal review." Configure Prerequisites Before connecting Attio MCP, ensure you have: An active Attio workspace An MCP-compatible AI client (Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc). Connecting to Attio MCP Attio MCP uses OAuth authentication, so you simply log in with your Attio account—no API keys required. ​ For Claude Desktop or Claude.ai: Open Settings -> Connectors -> Browse connectors Search for Attio Install Attio For ChatGPT: Open Apps Search for Attio Connect Attio For other MCP clients: Add https://mcp.attio.com/mcp as a remote MCP server and complete the OAuth authentication when prompted. Once connected, you’ll be authenticated as your Attio user with access to your workspace data. pages.title: Attio plans and features | Attio Help Center (https://attio.com/help/reference/workspace-settings-billing/attio-plans-and-features)
pages.text: Attio plans and features | Attio Help Center Help / Reference / Workspace settings & billing / Attio plans and features Table of Contents Free plan Plus plan Pro plan Governance add-on Ultra plan (formerly Enterprise) This article provides a detailed overview of the features available in each of Attio's plans: Free, Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Ultra. Workspace admins can upgrade or change the plan at any time by visiting the Plans page within workspace settings. New workspaces begin with a 14-day free trial of the Pro plan, giving your team time to explore all Pro features before choosing a plan. For a full cost breakdown, including add-ons, visit our Pricing page . Each plan includes workspace credits for automations and AI features, and seat credits for Ask Attio. For details on how credits work, see Manage workspace and seat credits . Note: You can be a member of more than one workspace, but each workspace has a separate subscription and is billed separately. All workspace members must be on the same plan. For an overview of the Attio platform, see the Platform demo video in Attio Academy. Watch Free plan Copy link Ideal for very small teams (up to three seats). For additional seats, choose a paid plan. The Free plan includes the following features. Objects and records Copy link Use Companies and People objects, with an option to enable one additional standard object : Deals, Users, or Workspaces. Add up to 50k records to your workspace. Enrichment and communication intelligence Copy link Automatic data enrichment of company and person records with the following attributes: Name Description Logo or profile picture Category (companies only) Social media Location Communication intelligence attributes automatically populated for companies and people through email and calendar sync : First interaction Last interaction Connection strength Strongest connection Emails Copy link Sync one email and calendar mailbox per workspace member. Send up to 10 emails at once, with a monthly limit of 200 sends per user. Hourly and daily sending limits apply to each synced mailbox. All emails sent include "Sent with Attio". Permissions and access controls Copy link All of your workspace is fully visible and editable by all users. Email subject lines can be shared by default , with option to share individual emails manually . Reports Copy link Create up to three Insight type reports within the workspace. Ask Attio Copy link Receive 100 seat credits per seat per month for Ask Attio . Workspace credits Copy link Use up to 250 workspace credits per month for the workspace for AI features and workflow automations (no option to purchase additional credits). Apps and API Copy link Apps in Attio's App Store and access to Attio's API are available on all Attio plans. Support Copy link Attio's Help Center and Attio Academy Chat and email support Plus plan Copy link Ideal for small teams up to 10 seats. The Plus plan includes everything included on Free , and the following features. Objects and records Copy link Use Companies and People objects, with an option to enable three additional standard objects : Deals, Users, and Workspaces. Add up to 250k records to your workspace, with option to add more with record add-ons . Activities Copy link Log phone calls on records . Enrichment and communication intelligence Copy link Automatic data enrichment of company and person records with all attributes included on Free , plus: Employee count on companies ARR on companies Communication intelligence attributes automatically populated for companies and people through email and calendar sync with all attributes included on Free , plus: First email interaction Last email interaction First calendar interaction Last calendar interaction Logged standard activities built on the Interaction schema, such as phone calls, also count toward First interaction and Last interaction. Emails Copy link Sync one email and calendar mailbox per workspace member. Send up to 50 emails at once, with a monthly limit of 1,000 sends per user. Hourly and daily sending limits apply to each synced mailbox. Option to remove "Sent with Attio" from emails. Permissions and access controls Copy link Manage workspace-wide access for all team members together for objects , lists , workflows , and reporting dashboards . Email subject lines or full access to emails can be shared by default with the whole workspace. Individual emails can be shared manually . Reports Copy link Create up to 20 Insight and Funnel reports within the workspace. Use Segment by feature to break down data in bar and line reports by another attribute. Ask Attio Copy link Receive 500 seat credits per seat per month for Ask Attio . Workspace credits Copy link Use up to 1,500 workspace credits per month for the workspace for AI features and workflow automations, with option to purchase more as needed. Record summaries Copy link AI-generated summaries of records on record pages, record previews, and hover cards. Record summaries don't use credits. Support Copy link Attio's Help Center and Attio Academy Chat and email support Pro plan Copy link Ideal for scaling businesses, with no seat limit. The Pro plan includes everything included on Plus , and the following features. Objects, records, and attributes Copy link Use up to 12 objects included in your plan, in any combination of standard objects and custom objects . Companies and People count toward this limit. Purchase up to eight more objects with the extra objects add-on , for a maximum of 20. For more than 20 objects, upgrade to Ultra. Add up to 1 million records to your workspace, with option to add more with record add-ons . Create custom bi-directional relationship attributes to connect records. ( System relationship attributes are available on all plans.) Create custom templates to tailor which attributes appear when creating new records or adding records to lists. Create formula attributes on any object or list to calculate values automatically from other attributes. Create up to eight rules per object . Activities Copy link Create custom activities and schemas to track any interaction your team logs, such as product demos or site visits. Enrichment and communication intelligence Copy link Automatic data enrichment of company and person records with all attributes included on Plus , and: Funding raised on companies Communication intelligence attributes automatically populated for companies and people through email and calendar sync with all attributes included on Plus , and: Next calendar interaction Custom activities built on the Interaction schema also count toward First interaction and Last interaction. Emails Copy link Sync two email and calendar mailboxes per workspace member. Send up to 50 emails at once, with no monthly sending limit per user. Hourly and daily sending limits apply to each synced mailbox. Use email sequences to automate email sending. Permissions and access controls Copy link Create up to 10 teams to assign access and collaborate more efficiently. Manage workspace, team, and individual access for objects , lists , workflows , and reporting dashboards . Email subject lines or full access can be shared by default with the whole workspace, with option to limit full access to specific individuals. Add specific domains and emails to the workspace protected and blocked contacts list to hide emails and calendar events. Add them to the record suppression list to prevent Attio from automatically creating them as records. Manually share individual emails , or all emails associated with a record . Reports Copy link Create up to 100 Insight , Funnel , Time in stage , Historical values , and Stage changed reports within the workspace. In addition to the Segment by feature included on Plus, set Targets on bar and line reports to display progress, report on Historical attributes, and make Time comparisons between current period values and previous periods. Ask Attio Copy link Receive 1,000 seat credits per seat per month for Ask Attio . Workspace credits Copy link Use up to 10,000 workspace credits per month for the workspace for AI features and workflow automations, with option to purchase more as needed. Call recording Copy link Record calls with Attio with AI-powered transcripts and insights. Admin and support Copy link Attio's Help Center and Attio Academy Option to pay by invoice Priority Support via chat and email Option to purchase the Governance add-on for SSO, SCIM, audit logs, and export controls. Governance add-on Copy link Governance is a paid add-on for the Pro plan that adds security and compliance controls for your workspace. It's included on the Ultra plan. Admins on any Pro workspace can add Governance from the Billing page in workspace settings. It's billed for each seat in the workspace. Governance includes: SAML and Single Sign-On (SSO) SCIM user provisioning Export audit logs of changes made in your workspace Option to limit exports to workspace admins Ultra plan (formerly Enterprise) Copy link Ideal for teams and orgs running multiple GTM motions at scale, with no seat limit. The Ultra plan includes everything included on Pro , and the following features. Note: Ultra replaced the Enterprise plan for new workspaces starting in November 2026. The features below apply to both the Ultra and Enterprise plans unless stated otherwise. Objects, records, and attributes Copy link All features on Pro , plus: Use unlimited objects . Create rules on objects with no limit, and choose specific members, teams, or workflows that each rule includes or excludes. Add up to 3 million records, unless your workspace has a custom limit. Admins can see the workspace’s records limit on the Billing page in workspace settings. To add more, purchase record add-ons or contact Attio’s Sales team. Emails Copy link All features on Pro , plus: Sync unlimited email and calendar mailboxes. Send up to 50 emails at once, with unlimited monthly sends per user. Hourly and daily sending limits apply to each synced mailbox. Permissions and access controls Copy link All features on Pro , plus: Create unlimited teams to assign access and collaborate more efficiently. Reports Copy link All features on Pro , plus: Create unlimited reports . Ask Attio Copy link Receive 2,500 seat credits per seat per month for Ask Attio . Suggestions (Beta) Copy link Get suggestions for your next steps , such as record updates, email replies, and tasks, based on your emails and calls. Workspace credits Copy link Use up to 20,000 workspace credits per month for AI features and workflow automations, unless your workspace has a custom limit. Admins can see the workspace’s credit limit on the Billing page in workspace settings. To add more, purchase additional credits or contact Attio’s Sales team. Admin and support Copy link All features on Pro , plus: Governance included: SSO, SCIM, audit logs, and the option to limit exports to workspace admins. Option to end user sessions See all workspace members' synced accounts and sync status for email, calendar, and cloud storage accounts. Query workspace data with SQL using the SQL query workflow block. Did this article answer your question? Yes No Search... ⌘K

pages.title: Attio MCP: prompts and best practices | Attio Help Center (https://attio.com/help/reference/how-to-guides/attio-mcp-prompts-and-best-practices)
pages.text: Attio MCP: prompts and best practices | Attio Help Center Help / Reference / How-to guides / Attio MCP: prompts and best practices Table of Contents How the connection works Before you start Connect your AI assistant Verify the connection Prompt library Best practices for prompting Troubleshooting Related resources Available on all plans. Available for all workspace members. Attio MCP connects external AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT to your Attio workspace, so you can search your CRM, update records, log notes, and manage tasks in natural language from wherever you already work with AI. This guide covers connecting Attio to your AI assistant, verifying the connection, and a library of role-based prompts for getting real work done, whether you run the whole company, RevOps, or your own book of business. How the connection works Copy link MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard that lets AI assistants securely interact with other systems. Your AI assistant connects to Attio's MCP server, you sign in with your Attio account, and the assistant can then use a set of Attio tools: searching records, creating and updating records, working with notes and tasks, managing views, and reading emails and meeting data. See the full list of the Attio MCP’s tools . Three things are worth understanding before you connect: It acts as you. The AI assistant authenticates as your Attio user through OAuth. It can only see and change what your own permissions allow. You control what runs without asking. By default, your AI assistant asks for your approval before running most Attio tools. In your assistant's settings, you can allow specific tools, like read tools that search and view data, to run without asking. If you're in a managed workspace on your AI assistant, the available options may be restricted, e.g. write tools can’t be set to Always allow . It works alongside Ask Attio, not instead of it. Ask Attio is AI inside Attio and needs no setup. MCP is for working outside Attio, where you can combine your CRM with other tools and data the assistant can reach. Learn more about when to use Attio MCP or Ask Attio . Before you start Copy link You need an Attio account on any plan. All workspace members can use the MCP. You need an AI assistant that supports MCP connections, such as Claude or ChatGPT. Whether connectors are available can depend on your plan with that assistant, and if your AI assistant is managed by an admin, you may need them to enable the Attio connector. Know which workspace you want to connect. If you belong to more than one Attio workspace, you choose one during sign-in. Connect your AI assistant Copy link Claude and ChatGPT connect through their built-in connector directories, and any other MCP-compatible assistant connects using the server URL https://mcp.attio.com/mcp . Follow the setup steps for your assistant in the Attio MCP developer documentation , signing in with your Attio account when prompted. Once connected, Attio appears in your assistant's list of connected tools, and it can answer questions about your workspace. Verify the connection Copy link Confirm the assistant is talking to the right workspace with a read-only prompt in your AI assistant: Which Attio workspace am I connected to, and what access level do I have? Copy Then try a real lookup: Find the company record for [a domain you know is in your CRM, e.g. attio.com] and summarize what we know. Copy The assistant should name your intended workspace and return real record data. If it names a different workspace, disconnect and reconnect, then pick the right workspace during sign-in. Prompt library Copy link Copy any prompt and replace the values in [square brackets] with your own. Some prompts pair Attio with another tool, like Slack, Linear, Intercom, or Apollo. To run those, your AI assistant needs a connection to that tool as well, and the tools named are examples, so swap in the ones your team uses. Quick lookups to start with Copy link Here are some single-line prompts that work as soon as you're connected. Find the decision maker: In Attio, who's the decision maker at [Meridian Labs]? Copy Find team conversations about a customer (with Slack) : What has the team said about [Brightline] in Slack over the last month? Copy If you manage your own pipeline Copy link Reps with back-to-back calls use these prompts to keep their pipeline current without living in the CRM. Prep for a call (with Intercom) : I have a renewal call with [Meridian Labs] at [2pm]. Pull the deal history, associated people, and open tasks from Attio, and check Intercom for their recent support conversations. Give me a one-page brief and flag anything that I should be aware of for the conversation. Copy Update after a call: Review my last call with [Meridian Labs] in Attio. Move the deal to [Negotiation], log a note with the key points and objections, create follow-up tasks with deadlines, and draft the follow-up email for me to review. Copy Answer a product question mid-deal (with Linear) : [Meridian Labs] asked about [SSO support] on today's call. Check the status of that work in Linear and log a note on their Attio deal with what I can share and a realistic timeline. Copy One thing to know about email drafting: Attio MCP doesn't draft or send email. It supplies the context, like notes, transcripts, and deal history, and your AI assistant writes the draft in your conversation. From here you can: Copy the draft: Paste it into your mail client, review, and send. Connect your email to the assistant: If your assistant also connects to your mailbox, such as Claude with Gmail, it can place the draft there directly for you to review and send. Either way, if your mailbox is synced with Attio , the sent email lands on the record automatically. If you're a founder running sales solo Copy link Use the MCP to keep the CRM current without living in it, and to grow your pipeline from what's already working. Log a conversation from anywhere: I met [Dana Okafor] from [Brightline] at an event today, their email is [dana@brightline.io]. Create person and company records if we don't have them, note that [they're evaluating CRMs for a 12-person sales team], and set a task to follow up on [Thursday]. Copy Find your next customers from your best ones (with Apollo) : Find the [10] records with the highest [ARR] in Attio and take their associated companies. Use their domains to look them up in Apollo, then find [20] similar companies by industry, employee count, and location. Create company records in Attio for any we don't already have, with a task to research each. Copy If you run RevOps or admin the workspace Copy link MCP lets you run data quality checks and ad hoc audits, and you can give your whole team leverage by standardizing the prompts that work. Audit data quality: Show me open deals missing a value for Close date or Deal owner. List the attribute options for Deal stage first so we use the exact names. Copy Check support health before an outreach push (with Intercom) : I'm about to run an expansion push on [companies with an open deal]. Check Intercom for any with unresolved or escalated conversations, I don't want to pitch anyone mid-complaint. Copy Build a targeted list: In Attio, build me a call list: companies in [fintech] with an open deal and no contact from us in the last [30 days]. Include the deal owner and the best person to reach at each. Copy The prompts that survive daily use are worth standardizing. Write the best ones into a shared doc, or save them as reusable prompts or skills in your AI assistant, so every rep runs the same reliable version instead of improvising. Best practices for prompting Copy link Here are a few prompting habits to help you get the best results from the Attio MCP: Name records precisely. Use a full name plus company, or better, a unique value like an email address or domain. Say which object you mean. "Create a deal for Brightline" is clearer than "add Brightline," which could mean a company, a person, or a list entry. Use attribute names as they appear in Attio. If you're unsure, ask the assistant to list an object's attributes first, then reference the exact names and options. Include a unique value when creating records. Provide an email address for person records or a domain for company records. Attio deduplicates automatically when a unique value is provided, so Attio can update existing records or create them if they don’t exist. Ask for a change log. End write requests with "list everything you changed, with links to the records." Then spot-check the record in Attio while you're learning which phrasings work reliably. Troubleshooting Copy link The assistant says it can't see a record you know exists: Your Attio permissions apply to the connection too. Read access to objects and records can't be restricted per member, but list access can be. If a list is restricted for you, the assistant can't see its entries either. Changes appear in the wrong workspace: The connection was authorized against a different workspace. Disconnect the Attio connector in your AI assistant, reconnect, and choose the correct workspace during sign-in. Duplicate records after the assistant creates: Creation prompts without a unique value can produce duplicates. Include an email address for people or a domain for companies, and Attio matches to the existing record automatically. Requests start failing after heavy use: MCP applies rate limits per workspace. Ask the assistant to slow down or run operations one at a time, then retry. Normal conversational use stays well within limits. Related resources Copy link Get the full tool list, rate limits, and technical setup in the Attio MCP developer documentation . Understand the in-product agent, Ask Attio .
